correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the local predicate from the actual graph: singles cannot survive, a double requires both adjacent columns to contain its rows, and a full column requires their union to cover all rows. For n≥3 a trace walk counts a labeled cyclic word once with one weight per column; the two shorter powers are formal only. The 13 possible recurrent pairs connect both ways to FF and FF has a self-loop. In the symmetric sector the rows for EE/FE and DD/FD coincide; on their equal-coordinate image the five coordinates EE,EF,FF,DD,DF give the matrix with rows (1,1,0,0,0), (0,0,b,0,0), (b,0,b,3b,0), (0,0,0,a,a), (0,0,b,2b,0). Direct symbolic determinant gives P. In each of the two sum-zero color sectors the two double-center rows coincide and the image matrix has rows (a,a), (−b,0), giving Q. All other eigenvalues are zero. An independent direct four-neighbor bitmask enumeration matched every bivariate coefficient at n=3 through 6; trace powers also give 831 and 2145 at n=7 and 8. The primitive spectral gap persists locally under complex fugacity perturbation; the trace then gives analytic quasi-powers and the joint column proportions concentrate by the same first/second derivative argument as for occupation. The EE and FF self-loops have different rewards, so occupation variance cannot vanish by a coboundary. Independent high-precision evaluation gives α≈2.6074909962041324, σ²≈0.4451251123536428 and full-column fraction ≈0.5411126234832437; the corresponding frozen decimals have tiny final-digit errors, not errors in the exact characteristic or derivative definitions. No uploaded code was executed.

originality.rationale: The exact two-fugacity characteristic factor and the resulting uniform-ensemble law concern a different local predicate from the nearest indexed enumerations. Three-core/bootstrap duality and transfer/Perron methods are not new; the exact strip-specific census is not supplied by those methods without solving its recurrent-state structure.
residual_risks: The older primary papers were not available in full; equivalent closed-set or induced-minimum-degree enumeration could appear under different terminology.
The comparison is bounded and does not establish global priority.

value.rationale: The bivariate exact law gives all labeled frozen-state counts, including partial-column contributions that an all-full/empty approximation would miss, and supplies a usable benchmark for uniform core ensembles, including an entropy, concentration and a nondegenerate CLT. It does not describe the much different endpoint distribution from Bernoulli initial conditions.
